intent: Pick a date range from named presets such as This month or Last 30 days, or from two months side by side, then Apply.
useWhen: A report or filter period with presets like This month or Last 30 days
A start and end date in one field
doNotUseWhen: A range with no named presets — use DatePicker mode=range
A schedule of events — use Calendar

presets.note: Replaces Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, and Last month. Each item is { id, label, start, end }.

requirements: Trigger is a button with aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, and aria-controls
Overlay is role=dialog aria-modal labelled Choose dates and contains the month grid

Presets sit on the start and two months side by side (one below 40rem). A preset, or a first and second day click, sets a pending range; Apply commits it and closes. Cancel, Escape, or a click outside leave the value as it was
Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. Tab stays inside the dialog
Must have a Field label pointing at id

doNot: Do not wrap DateRangePicker in Popover. Do not invent a second calendar or a native input type=date
Do not use two DatePickers for start and end
Do not add time — ask first
